invariants.rationale: According to the logic, selection is set to either the found item, the first item, or cleared if there are no items. Therefore, if items.size > 0, selection.get() is non-null.

meta.value: If there are any items, something is always selected.

invariants.rationale: If item is in items per contains, then selection.set(item) is called, so selection.get() == item.

meta.value: If the item is contained, it should be set as selection.

invariants.rationale: items.contains(item, false) can only be true if items.size > 0.

meta.value: If item is contained, items must not be empty.

invariants.rationale: When items is non-empty, the selection is always set to an item from items.

meta.value: If any items are present, selection.get() will be a valid item.
Redundant with first, for clarity: when there are items, some item is selected.
